models.train_protocol_notes: VAE trained via a LOCAL ELBO loop (D-10-09): single Adam(lr=1e-3), NO critic / NO n_critic / NO gradient penalty; loss = MSE(x_hat,x) + beta*KLD, beta=1.0 (no KL warmup applied). sample() emits directly in the [-1,1] window space — the WGAN *0.1 scaling is a quantum-output artifact and is deliberately NOT applied to VAE samples (RESEARCH Pitfall 3).
